newsitem.title: FRANCE: British supermodel denies love row, suicide bid.
newsitem.headline: British supermodel denies love row, suicide bid.

text.p: British model Naomi Campbell, who was briefly treated in a Canary Islands hospital last weekend, has denied she tried to take her life after quarrelling with her Spanish boyfriend.
She told the French weekly Paris Match in an interview published on Thursday there was no row and no suicide bid.
"I am shocked by the publicity given to this. My grandmother, my whole family were horrified by the rumours although they fully well know that I am not the type to commit suicide," she said.
The model was taken semi-conscious from her five-star hotel on the Spanish island of Gran Canaria early last Sunday. Her agent has said she resumed work in Paris on Monday.

A hospital source said she suffered a drugs overdose, and local media speculated that she had tried to commit suicide after witnesses said she had an argument with her boyfriend, 28-year-old flamenco dancer Joaquin Cortes who had been photographed with another woman.
She said she had stomach pains and denied she had taken any barbiturates or tranquillisers.
"I suffered an allergy to antibiotics. Tuna fish does the same thing to me," she said.
Campbell said her romance with Cortes, dubbed "sex on legs" for his steamy dancing, was continuing and she hoped they would go on holiday to Jamaica where she owns a house near her grandparents.
